description: Write text only inside the agent's own workspace: create (default, refuses existing files), append (creates if missing), or replace (requires an existing file). Limit: 262144 UTF-8 bytes per call; missing parent folders are created. Paths outside the workspace, or inside your own stack or definition folder, are refused (PathBad). Example: ws_write {"path": "notes/report.md", "content": "Report\n", "mode": "create"}.

path.description: the file, relative to AOS_WS, or absolute inside it; symlinks are resolved

content.description: text to write, at most 262144 UTF-8 bytes; no newline is added

mode.description: create refuses existing files; append creates if missing; replace requires an existing file
